Requirements: Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree in music or its equivalent from an accredited institution. A minimum grade point average of 3.0 in the last 60 units of study is required for admission to the program. A successful performance audition is required for all performance applicants. Additional materials include three letters of recommendation, a professional resume, and a statement of purpose. All graduate students in the MM program must take placement examinations in music history and music theory. For Vocal Performance specifically, foreign language proficiency in French, German, and Italian is expected.
Program name: Master of Music in Vocal Performance (Opera Emphasis)
